title: My Sadistic Boyfriend
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High-school student Chiaki wins a place at an elite boarding school and ends up rooming with Katsuho, the director's grandson and the school's 'prince'. Kind in public, he is domineering in private, kissing her forcefully and pinning her down, and she quickly decides she loves him. The seven-volume shoujo romance follows their relationship through school events.
life_message: Love is shown as winning over a domineering partner whose hidden side only the heroine sees.

winners_losers: Katsuho wins Chiaki's devotion; the reviewer notes her agency loses out. Sympathy goes to the couple's romance rather than to critique of his behaviour.
